pharmacology.kind: Norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor; Serotonin–norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor

uses.text: Ampreloxetine (INN, USAN; developmental code name TD-9855) is a selective norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (NRI) which is under development for the treatment of symptomatic neurogenic orthostatic hypotension (NOH). As of November 2023, ampreloxetine is in phase 3 clinical trials for NOH.

sideEffects.en: In trials the reported effects included raised blood pressure when lying down, headache, urinary problems and dry mouth. It is still under study, so its long-term effects are not known.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中回報的反應包括躺下時血壓升高、頭痛、排尿問題與口乾。它仍在研究階段，因此長期影響不明。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中回报的反应包括躺下时血压升高、头痛、排尿问题与口干。它仍在研究阶段，因此长期影响不明。

fact.en: It is being developed for neurogenic orthostatic hypotension, where the nerves fail to tighten blood vessels on standing so blood pressure falls. By keeping noradrenaline around longer, it helps the vessels respond.
fact.zh: 它正在開發用於神經性姿勢性低血壓，也就是起身時神經無法收縮血管而導致血壓下降。它讓正腎上腺素停留更久，幫助血管做出反應。
fact.zhHans: 它正在开发用于神经性姿势性低血压，也就是起身时神经无法收缩血管而导致血压下降。它让正肾上腺素停留更久，帮助血管做出反应。
